purpose: Field-level dependency baseline for reconstructing the effective Stage 01-06 behavior from raw session JSONL without preserving the historical stage layout.

evidence_classes.code_behavior: Static or directly inspected executable behavior in the legacy source tree.
evidence_classes.document_statement: Normative or explanatory text; draft status is preserved and does not imply execution.
evidence_classes.historical_artifact: Observed schema, manifest, count, hash, or frozen output from the four historical batches.
evidence_classes.test_behavior: Behavior asserted by legacy tests; to be cataloged in implementation phase.
evidence_classes.new_design: Proposed canonical behavior, not a claim about history.

authoritative_history.note: A later 172-candidate review version for one batch is outside the frozen first-selection 780 baseline.

capability_nodes.capability: Read native session JSONL and preserve source identity.
Normalize heterogeneous native records into trace, turn, and event records while retaining source references.

evidence.observation: All four frozen batches have unified trace and turn artifacts.

capability_nodes.capability: Recover task episodes, boundaries, initial query, user goal, requirement origin/evolution, domain, analysis value, and user-side candidate signals from real user events.
invariants: User-only analysis must not infer Agent failure or capability gaps.
Episode boundaries are task-goal boundaries, not arbitrary turn windows.
Each requirement, change, and signal must cite an exact user event and quote.

capability_nodes.historical_stage: Stage 03 agent verify (and early combined Stage 02 runs)
capability_nodes.capability: Read assistant, tool, error, and follow-up evidence to confirm/revise goals, evaluate each requirement, classify outcome, and separate Agent-related failure from permission, external, or user causes.
invariants: Agent claimed completion is not evidence-verified completion.
Tool calls do not prove successful execution; corresponding results are required.
Insufficient evidence remains unknown/reviewable rather than becoming failure.

capability_nodes.capability: Build one case per verified Episode and deterministically expose historical Agent attribution status with evidence and source references.

decision_table.when: agent_related is null/missing or evidence/required fields are unresolved

invariants: pain_judgment is Agent attribution, not task outcome, trace quality, label support, or final selection.
Stage 05 publishing does not contribute new semantic judgments.

capability_nodes.historical_stage: Stage 06 source index and evidence retrieval
capability_nodes.capability: Reload the authoritative Episode plus the next real-user lookahead, verify source identity, index all events, and selectively retrieve exact tool bodies without silently truncating evidence.
invariants: Boundary start/end must exist in the same trace and source batch.
The query turn must lie inside the Episode.
Every quote must be a continuous substring of a provided event body.
Omitted tool bodies must never be treated as verified evidence.

capability_nodes.capability: Produce requirements, task attributes, taxonomy mappings, assessments, feedback/failure annotations, claims, evidence references, and limitations with explicit evidence support.
invariants: claims[].support_status evaluates one field_path claim, not the whole trace.
capability_mapping[].mapping_status evaluates requirement-taxonomy mapping, not claim evidence support.
review_view is deterministically derived and is not an independent source of truth.
Primary requirements req_001-req_033 and auxiliary-only req_034-req_036 remain distinct.

capability_nodes.capability: Override claim support only through version-bound review records and preserve reviewer identity and cited evidence.
invariants: Model initial support is not human verification.
A corrected review must be applied to a new label version before selection.
Disagreeing or unaccepted reviews resolve to unknown, not an arbitrary winner.

capability_nodes.capability: Evaluate S3/S4 (and explicitly supplied S1/S2 audits) against existing supported claims and exact evidence without inventing task labels.
invariants: Rule checks are selection execution records, not semantic task attributes.
Pass/fail must cite usable supported claims; unknown evidence becomes pending.
S3/S4 may register exact additional quotes only from bodies already provided.

capability_nodes.capability: Apply prechecks and S1-S4 deterministically and emit a versioned selection decision with hashes and reasons.

decision_table.canonical: invalid or pending_review, distinguished by error class

decision_table.when: scope_match == fail or any S1-S4 == fail

capability_nodes.historical_stage: Stage 05 publishing plus Stage 06 reports/session export
capability_nodes.capability: Validate contracts, detect conflicts and missing provenance, export selected native sessions, and compare new runs with frozen historical results.
invariants: Export must join selection to source lineage explicitly; null source fields in historical selection records are not acceptable canonical lineage.
Publishing views are generated from canonical records and cannot introduce labels.

prechecks.valid_label_and_references.behavior: Invalid labels become legacy review; canonical design separates invalid processing state from semantic pending review.

prechecks.scope_match.behavior: Empty filters mean no restriction. Episode attributes cannot silently define case-requirement scope.

derived_from: claims cited by active S1-S4 checks

S1.criterion: At least one primary req_001-req_033 parent and concrete child mapping is supported by usable claims.

S2.criterion: Episode difficulty is medium/high and its field claim is supported; reviewed low fails; unknown or unreviewed low remains pending.

S3.criterion: The same task's goal, object, requirements, constraints, evolution, and scope can be coherently reconstructed.
S3.execution: Historically model-reviewed when pending; final record is a separate selection audit, not a task label.

S4.criterion: Completion conditions are explicit in user requirements or linked tests, expected outputs, metrics, or checkable standards.

disabled_or_nonsemantic_components.reason: Policy status is pending_redesign_separate_trace_quality_from_label_support and enabled=false; it did not drive the frozen first-selection results.
Selection verifies it equals a deterministic rebuild from labels/claims/evidence and then removes it before semantic checks.
It formats Stage 04 outputs and is not a semantic dependency for Stage 06.

open_design_questions: Freeze canonical taxonomy IDs and enumerations after reviewing the mapping document.
Define the exact boundary between analyzability quality and per-label evidence support before enabling any trace_quality aggregate.
Catalog legacy test assertions and the known 123 labeling failures / 58 boundary anomalies before claiming compatibility.
Choose deterministic ten-session regression sample and freeze its expected layered outputs.
